name: Airplane Audit Report
report_script:
import frappe
def execute(filters=None):
    # Fetch all airplanes and their audits
    airplanes = frappe.get_all("Airplane", fields=["name"])
    data = []

    for airplane in airplanes:
        # Get all audits for the airplane
        audits = frappe.get_all("Airplane Audit", filters={"airplane": airplane.name}, fields=["audit_date", "audit_type", "status", "audit_result", "inspector"])
        
        for audit in audits:
            data.append({
                "Airplane": airplane.name,
                "Audit Date": audit.audit_date,
                "Audit Type": audit.audit_type,
                "Status": audit.status,
                "Audit Result": audit.audit_result,
                "Inspector": audit.inspector
            })

    return data
